name: Death Cultist Base Camp
summary: In the year 25 ADP, this location west of Tyr's Hand is known as the Scarlet Base Camp, an armed enclave of the Scarlet Crusade overlooking the road into their southeastern fortress. Travelers here will find zealots of the crusade guarding the blighted hills.

sections.title: A Crusader Staging Ground
sections.body: Occupying high ground along the winding path toward Tyr's Hand, this outpost serves the Scarlet Crusade as an advanced guard post in the southeastern Eastern Plaguelands. From here, crusaders mount watches against both wandering undead and interloping travelers traveling along the blighted trails. While Scourge necromancers covet the territory for their dark arts, the camp remains firmly in the clutches of Scarlet zealots who answer any trespass with righteous steel.

faq.q: Why is this area called Death Cultist Base Camp?
faq.answer: In 25 ADP this encampment is known as the Scarlet Base Camp, not a death cultist camp. It serves as an outer defensive position for the Scarlet Crusade guarding the approach to Tyr's Hand.

faq.q: Who controls this encampment right now?
faq.answer: The camp is manned by soldiers of the Scarlet Crusade. They treat all outsiders—both the mindless Scourge and living travelers of the Alliance or Horde—as tainted enemies.
It sits nestled in the hills of the southeastern Eastern Plaguelands, positioned directly west of the grand scarlet bastion of Tyr's Hand.

angles.text: The camp stands as a sobering reminder of how far the Scarlet Crusade has fallen, twisting the righteous light into paranoid zealotry against all outside their ranks.
